settings.empty: No settings for this service yet.

campaigns.label: Demo campaigns
campaigns.help: Demo campaigns that no service above runs on.

widget.avatarHint: Shown on the launcher bubble, the chat header and every reply, in every widget demo.
widget.avatarError: That image could not be read. Try a PNG, JPG or WebP.

voice.voicesHint: Which voice answers the phone in each language. Changes reach the next call, not one already running.
voice.engineDown: Could not reach the voice engine, so these cannot be edited right now.
voice.passwordHint: Extra words that open the demo page, separated by commas. The built-in ones keep working.
voice.forgetHint: Sara greets these numbers as a new caller every time, on every line (clients' lines too), so a demo from your own phone always starts fresh. Separate with commas.
voice.limitHint: How long one demo call may run before it ends itself.

engines.title: Engine tests
engines.hint: Calls from these numbers to the demo line are answered by the engine, voice and prompt you pick here. Every other caller keeps the line's own setup. Takes effect within 30 seconds.
engines.retired: Grok is retired: calls from this number are answered by GPT-Live. Pick an engine to change that.
engines.xaiMissing: Grok is not set up yet (missing {{missing}}): these calls stay on GPT-Live until it is.
engines.elevenMissing: ElevenLabs is not set up yet (missing {{missing}}): these calls stay on GPT-Live until it is.
engines.label: Name
engines.freshCaller: Memory off (sounds like a first-time caller)
engines.freshCallerHint: This number's earlier calls, name, language and appointments are hidden from the AI. Bookings still go to the diary.

eleven.title: ElevenLabs demos
eleven.hint: The engine minted demo links and demo phone calls run on, and the voice each language speaks with.
eleven.engineHint: ElevenLabs sounds best in Dutch. GPT-Live is the old engine, kept as a fallback.
eleven.voicesHint: The default voice of each demo locale. A voice picked on a demo itself wins. Press play to hear it.
eleven.phonesHint: Your phone rings first, then the prospect is added to the call. Empty fields use the number shown.

widgetColor.title: Widget colour
widgetColor.hint: Colours the launcher button only. Detected from their website; black when there is none.

clientLogo.title: Client logo
clientLogo.hint: Shown instead of the initials in the Instagram and Reputation demos. Applies to every demo of this Client.
clientLogo.none: No logo yet: the initials show.
clientLogo.noWebsite: This Client has no website on file.

calls.hint: "Sara calls now" rings the prospect with Sara on the line. "Call me + prospect" rings you first, then them; bring Sara in when you are ready.
calls.gone: That call is no longer running (the call engine restarted). You can start a new one.
